final: WITH j AS (SELECT r.rental_id AS rental_id, i.store_id AS store_id, p.amount AS amount FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id), rt AS (SELECT rental_id, store_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM j GROUP BY rental_id, store_id), sa AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rt GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS kept_total, AVG(rt.total - sa.avg_total) AS avg_diff FROM rt JOIN sa ON rt.store_id = sa.store_id WHERE rt.total > sa.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
